key.name: position-in-panel
key.description: Where to place the indicator in the panel (left, center, right, or left-half, which fills the space up to the clock)

key.name: lyrics-offset
key.description: Time in milliseconds to show lyrics before they are sung

key.name: show-lyrics
key.description: Show synced lyrics in the top bar and over the album art

key.name: show-album-art
key.description: Show the album art in the dropdown (Spotify only)

key.name: track-info-style
key.description: How the title, artist and buttons stay readable over the album art: a dark shade behind them, or colors that invert the cover beneath

key.name: toggle-menu-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens or closes the dropdown

key.name: refresh-player-request
key.description: Bumped by the preferences window to make the extension look for the active player again
